policy_overrides.description: Optional map on each scenario overriding defaults before replay
policy_overrides.feature_scale_mode: global or per_device replaces scenario feature_scale_mode when present
policy_overrides.calibration_gate: boolean replaces scenario calibration_gate default and controls whether SET_CALIBRATION version is checked against REGISTER_MODEL calibration_version

event_order: sort ascending by seq then region_id then sample_id never by event_id alone; at equal seq REGISTER_REGION precedes LOCK_SAMPLE when region_id ties because sample_id is empty on region registration; scenario_65_example seq 2 lock row listed before register row still registers first

deduplication.empty_event_id: blank event_id rows are never treated as duplicate event_id matches; only non empty event_id values participate in deduplication
deduplication.scenario_48_example: two LOCK_SAMPLE rows both with event_id empty are both accepted and duplicate_events_skipped stays 0
deduplication.equal_seq_tiebreak: when two rows share event_id at the same seq replay sort order decides which is kept; lexicographically smaller region_id wins
deduplication.scenario_50_example: seq 5 eu-west and us-east locks both event_id dup keeps eu-west raw 100.0 and skips us-east raw 200.0 with duplicate_events_skipped 1

duplicate_sample.trigger: a second LOCK_SAMPLE for the same region_id and sample_id even when event_id differs
duplicate_sample.event_seq: seq of the rejected second LOCK_SAMPLE
duplicate_sample.policy: keep the first lock only; ignore the second lock body and do not update Welford stats for it
duplicate_sample.scenario_13_example: seq 3 locks s1 then seq 4 locks s1 again with a different event_id yields DUPLICATE_SAMPLE at seq 4 detail s1 and normalized_features stay from the first lock
duplicate_sample.scenario_24_example: after DUPLICATE_SAMPLE at seq 4 a later lock s2 at seq 5 must normalize using Welford stats from the first s1 lock only not the rejected duplicate values

unknown_region.trigger: LOCK_SAMPLE QUANTIZE_SAMPLE or RUN_INFERENCE when region_id was never REGISTER_REGION
unknown_region.detail: the triggering event kind string such as LOCK_SAMPLE or RUN_INFERENCE
unknown_region.scenario_09_example: RUN_INFERENCE on ap-south without REGISTER_REGION detail RUN_INFERENCE
unknown_region.scenario_21_example: LOCK_SAMPLE on ap-south without REGISTER_REGION detail LOCK_SAMPLE
unknown_region.scenario_34_example: QUANTIZE_SAMPLE on ap-south without REGISTER_REGION detail QUANTIZE_SAMPLE

normalization.algorithm: online Welford only never batch mean over the full scenario
normalization.global: Welford mean and std per channel index within each region across LOCK_SAMPLE rows seen before each lock in seq order regardless of sample_id
normalization.per_device: Welford stats scoped to region_id and device_id per channel; stats from one device_id must never affect normalization for another device_id in the same region
normalization.first_lock: when no prior samples exist for the scope return raw feature unchanged not zero
normalization.per_channel_index: each channel index maintains its own Welford accumulator never a single mean over the full feature vector
normalization.scenario_38_example: locks 1,100 then 3,4 yield s2 normalized_features 2000000.0 and -96000000.0 on channels zero and one

quantization.note: scale multiplies after subtracting zero_point on decode

quant_mismatch.trigger: emit QUANT_MISMATCH when abs(dequant minus normalized x) greater than 1e-4 plus abs(x) times 1e-3 never scale divided by two
quant_mismatch.detail: zero based channel index as a decimal string not sample_id
quant_mismatch.scenario_03_example: first channel roundtrip error yields detail 0 at QUANTIZE_SAMPLE seq 5
quant_mismatch.scenario_25_example: features 1.0 and 0.33 with scale 0.1 zero_point 3 yields QUANT_MISMATCH detail 1 only on channel one while channel zero roundtrips
quant_mismatch.scenario_33_example: normalized 0.001 with scale 0.01 triggers QUANT_MISMATCH detail 0 under the spec formula but not under scale divided by two

out_of_range_quant.trigger: emit OUT_OF_RANGE_QUANT when abs(normalized x divided by scale) greater than 200
out_of_range_quant.detail: the clamped quantized q value as a decimal string not the channel index
out_of_range_quant.scenario_10_example: normalized 50.0 with scale 0.01 clamps to q 127 so detail is 127 at QUANTIZE_SAMPLE seq 5
out_of_range_quant.multi_flag: one QUANTIZE_SAMPLE may emit OUT_OF_RANGE_QUANT on one channel and QUANT_MISMATCH on another
out_of_range_quant.scenario_45_example: features 200.0 and 0.001 with scale 0.01 emit OUT_OF_RANGE detail 127 on channel zero plus QUANT_MISMATCH detail 0 and QUANT_MISMATCH detail 1 at seq 4

calibration.gate: When calibration_gate true after applying scenario calibration_gate field and policy_overrides, SET_CALIBRATION version must equal active REGISTER_MODEL calibration_version
calibration.default_region_calibration: When a region has no SET_CALIBRATION yet, RUN_INFERENCE uses active REGISTER_MODEL calibration_version and temperature 1.0
calibration.scenario_23_example: inference without SET_CALIBRATION still runs softmax at temperature 1.0
calibration.scenario_28_example: scenario calibration_gate true with policy_overrides calibration_gate false skips STALE_CALIBRATION on mismatched SET_CALIBRATION version
calibration.latest_calibration_wins: each SET_CALIBRATION replaces prior temperature and version for that region_id
calibration.scenario_35_example: temperature 2.0 at seq 3 then 0.5 at seq 4 means inference uses 0.5 via calibrate.js
calibration.non_positive_temperature: when stored temperature is zero or negative RUN_INFERENCE uses 1.0 instead
calibration.predicted_class: lowest index among classes with maximum calibrated probability

stale_calibration.emit_at: SET_CALIBRATION event when gate is on and ev.version differs from active REGISTER_MODEL calibration_version
stale_calibration.event_seq: seq of the SET_CALIBRATION event not RUN_INFERENCE
stale_calibration.sample_id: empty string in flag row sample_id field and underscore in flag_id third segment because no sample is locked yet
stale_calibration.flag_id_region_segment: actual SET_CALIBRATION region_id never underscore; scenario_04 uses us-east not underscore
stale_calibration.detail: the version string from the stale SET_CALIBRATION event such as v0 in scenario_04
stale_calibration.still_stores_temperature: always persist SET_CALIBRATION temperature for the region even when STALE_CALIBRATION is emitted; REVOKE_MODEL must not clear stored region temperatures; RUN_INFERENCE uses that stored positive temperature
stale_calibration.inactive_model: when model is not active after REVOKE_MODEL do not emit STALE_CALIBRATION on SET_CALIBRATION even if version mismatches
stale_calibration.scenario_04_example: flag_id scenario_04::us-east::_::0003 detail v0 at seq 3
stale_calibration.scenario_30_example: STALE at seq 3 with temperature 2.0 still yields softmax via calibrate.js 2.0 0.0 1.0 on inference
stale_calibration.scenario_37_example: SET_CALIBRATION v0 at seq 3 while model inactive emits no STALE_CALIBRATION
stale_calibration.inactive_still_persists: SET_CALIBRATION during model inactive still stores temperature for later RUN_INFERENCE after reactivation
stale_calibration.scenario_46_example: REVOKE then SET temperature 0.5 while inactive then REGISTER yields inference softmax via calibrate.js 0.5 1.0 1.1

class_collision.emit_at: RUN_INFERENCE after calibrate.js when two or more classes share the maximum probability
class_collision.predicted_class: lowest zero based index among tied maxima
class_collision.detail: comma separated sorted zero based class indices that tied for the maximum

json_output.empty_arrays: drift_flags normalized_features quantized dequantized and probabilities must serialize as json empty arrays [] when unset never null or omitted
json_output.drift_flags_empty: use an empty slice so drift_flags is [] in json not null when no flags were emitted
json_output.go_note: initialize drift_flags as make([]DriftFlag, 0) or []DriftFlag{} not nil before json.Marshal
json_output.deterministic_ordering: sort regions by region_id ascending samples within each region by sample_id ascending and drift_flags by flag_id ascending before json.Marshal; two consecutive make audit runs must be byte identical
json_output.object_keys_alphabetical: every JSON object in drift_audit_report.json must serialize keys in strict alphabetical order at all nesting levels matching output_schema.json key_order lists; Go struct field declaration order must match
json_output.build_output: make build must write driftaudit only to /app/build/driftaudit never /app/driftaudit

model_metadata.weights_digest: lowercase hex sha256 of weights_hex string bytes
model_metadata.still_activates_model: REGISTER_MODEL always sets model_version and activates inference even when METADATA_CORRUPT is emitted
model_metadata.scenario_31_example: bad digest flags METADATA_CORRUPT yet model_version stays v1 and RUN_INFERENCE succeeds

model_state.register_model: sets model_version to ev.version, stores calibration_version, marks model active for RUN_INFERENCE
model_state.replace_calibration_version: each REGISTER_MODEL replaces calibration_version used for later STALE_CALIBRATION checks
model_state.scenario_42_example: REGISTER c1 then REGISTER c2 then SET_CALIBRATION c1 emits STALE_CALIBRATION at seq 4
model_state.revoke_model: clears model_version to empty string and deactivates model; later RUN_INFERENCE emits MISSING_MODEL
model_state.reregister_model: a later REGISTER_MODEL after REVOKE_MODEL reactivates the model and replaces model_version and calibration_version
model_state.scenario_15_example: REVOKE_MODEL then RUN_INFERENCE yields model_version empty and MISSING_MODEL flag
model_state.scenario_22_example: REVOKE_MODEL then REGISTER_MODEL v2 yields model_version v2 and inference succeeds

status.consistent: no drift_flags emitted; status field must be the exact string CONSISTENT
status.drift_detected: at least one drift flag present; status field must be the exact string DRIFT_DETECTED
status.forbidden_values: never emit ok pass success or other aliases; only CONSISTENT and DRIFT_DETECTED are valid

sample_output_rows.inference_without_lock: RUN_INFERENCE on a registered region must create or update a sample output row with sample_id set, probabilities and predicted_class from calibrate.js, and normalized_features quantized and dequantized as json empty arrays [] when no LOCK_SAMPLE ran for that sample_id
sample_output_rows.quantize_without_lock: QUANTIZE_SAMPLE without a prior LOCK_SAMPLE for that region_id and sample_id must not emit quant flags and must not create a sample output row
sample_output_rows.scenario_58_example: RUN_INFERENCE sample s9 without lock still appears under us-east with predicted_class 0 and empty normalized_features quantized dequantized arrays
sample_output_rows.scenario_59_contrast: QUANTIZE without lock must not add that sample_id to region output

flag_details.METADATA_CORRUPT: detail is the bad weights_digest from REGISTER_MODEL; region_id and sample_id empty strings with both flag_id segments underscore such as scenario_58::_::_::0001
flag_details.MISSING_MODEL: detail is the RUN_INFERENCE kind string
flag_details.UNKNOWN_REGION: detail is the triggering event kind string
flag_details.QUANT_MISMATCH: detail is the zero based channel index as a decimal string
flag_details.OUT_OF_RANGE_QUANT: detail is the clamped quantized q value as a decimal string
flag_details.STALE_CALIBRATION: detail is the version string from the stale SET_CALIBRATION event such as v0 in scenario_04

post_replay_audit.event_seq: one plus the maximum seq field present in the scenario fixture events array including rows skipped by event_id deduplication
post_replay_audit.scenario_32_example: duplicate event_id lk1 at seq 10 is skipped yet post audit REGION_DIVERGENCE uses event_seq 11

region_divergence.canonical_region: lexicographically smallest region_id among regions that ran inference for the sample_id
region_divergence.divergent_region: any other region_id for the same sample_id whose predicted_class differs from the canonical region
region_divergence.flag_region_id: set to the divergent region_id not the canonical region
region_divergence.scenario_07_example: 1,us-east means canonical eu-west predicted class 1 and us-east diverged
region_divergence.scenario_20_example: 0,us-east means canonical eu-west predicted class 0 and us-east diverged
region_divergence.scenario_26_example: ap-south locked without inference is ignored; canonical eu-west class 1 yields us-east REGION_DIVERGENCE detail 1,us-east at post audit seq 12
region_divergence.scenario_43_example: eu-west class 0 and us-east class 1 yields REGION_DIVERGENCE detail 0,us-east not 1,us-east

post_replay_audit.region_divergence_class_gate: emit REGION_DIVERGENCE only when divergent region predicted_class differs from canonical predicted_class; identical classes with different normalized vectors must not emit REGION_DIVERGENCE
post_replay_audit.scenario_53_example: eu-west and us-east both predict class 0 with L2 10 emits FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT on us-east only and no REGION_DIVERGENCE at post audit seq 10
post_replay_audit.post_audit_min_regions: skip post replay REGION_DIVERGENCE and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT for a sample_id that appears in fewer than two regions
post_replay_audit.feature_scale_drift: When normalized L2 distance for same sample_id across regions is strictly greater than 0.5 emit FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT on the non canonical region with flag region_id set to that compared region and detail set to the canonical region_id
post_replay_audit.scenario_29_example: eu-west 0,0 and us-east 0.3,0.4 have L2 exactly 0.5 so no FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT is emitted
post_replay_audit.scenario_36_example: eu-west canonical with us-east vector 10,0 yields FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT flag region_id us-east detail eu-west at post audit seq 10
post_replay_audit.multi_region: emit one FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT per non canonical region whose L2 against canonical exceeds 0.5
post_replay_audit.scenario_40_example: ap-south canonical with eu-west and us-east drift vectors yields two FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT flags at event_seq 14 detail ap-south with flag_id scenario_40::eu-west::s1::0014 and scenario_40::us-east::s1::0014 and sample_id field s1 on each flag
post_replay_audit.dual_flags_same_region: one region may receive both REGION_DIVERGENCE and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT at the same post audit event_seq
post_replay_audit.scenario_47_example: eu-west class 0 us-east class 1 with L2 10 yields REGION_DIVERGENCE detail 0,us-east and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT detail eu-west both on us-east at seq 10 with sample_id s1 in flag_id
post_replay_audit.post_audit_sample_id: REGION_DIVERGENCE and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT post replay flags must set drift flag sample_id to the audited sample_id and use that same string as the flag_id third segment never underscore
post_replay_audit.scenario_52_example: sample s1 yields FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT flag_id scenario_52::us-east::s1::0014 and sample s2 yields REGION_DIVERGENCE flag_id scenario_52::us-east::s2::0014 at the same post audit event_seq 14
post_replay_audit.scenario_55_example: global mode lock s1 raw 10 then lock s2 raw 12 in same region yields s2 normalized_features 2000000.0 using region scoped Welford not per sample stats
post_replay_audit.scenario_56_example: SET_CALIBRATION temperature 0.25 before REGISTER_REGION still applies calibrate.js 0.25 1.0 1.0 on inference
post_replay_audit.scenario_57_example: policy_overrides feature_scale_mode per_device on a global scenario uses per device Welford like scenario_27
post_replay_audit.scenario_58_example: weights_digest mismatch compares sha256 of weights_hex ASCII string cafe not decoded bytes; detail is wrongdigest from the event
post_replay_audit.scenario_59_example: QUANTIZE_SAMPLE on a sample without LOCK_SAMPLE must not emit quant flags and must not create sample output rows
post_replay_audit.scenario_60_example: single region inference for sample s1 emits no post replay REGION_DIVERGENCE or FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT flags
post_replay_audit.scenario_61_example: SET_CALIBRATION temperature 0.75 survives REVOKE_MODEL and applies on inference after REGISTER_MODEL
post_replay_audit.scenario_62_example: logits 2.0 2.0 at SET_CALIBRATION temperature 2.0 emit CLASS_COLLISION detail 0,1
post_replay_audit.scenario_63_example: SET_CALIBRATION temperature -0.5 still stores the value but RUN_INFERENCE uses temperature 1.0 via calibrate.js 1.0 2.0 0.0
post_replay_audit.scenario_64_example: RUN_INFERENCE sample s9 without lock in eu-west and us-east yields two hash records sorted sample_id then region_id and two sample rows with empty feature arrays
post_replay_audit.scenario_65_example: seq 2 LOCK_SAMPLE listed before REGISTER_REGION still processes registration first so lock succeeds without UNKNOWN_REGION and inference runs

per_device_isolation.scenario_27_example: per_device mode locks s1 on d1 and s2 on d2 both raw then s3 on d1 normalizes against d1 stats only yielding 2000000.0 offsets not d2 stats

flag_id_format: {scenario_id}::{region_id or underscore}::{sample_id or underscore}::{event_seq as four zero padded digits}; METADATA_CORRUPT uses underscore in both region and sample segments when region_id and sample_id are empty; STALE_CALIBRATION uses the SET_CALIBRATION region_id in the region segment and underscore only in the sample segment; post replay REGION_DIVERGENCE and FEATURE_SCALE_DRIFT must use the actual sample_id in both flag_id and sample_id field

consistency_hash.summary: lowercase sha256 hex of a compact json array of inference records
consistency_hash.include_record_when: the sample ran RUN_INFERENCE so its probabilities array is non-empty; skip every locked or quantized sample that never produced probabilities
consistency_hash.record_key_order: object keys MUST be serialized in alphabetical order predicted_class then region_id then sample_id (equivalent to json.dumps with sort_keys true or Go map marshalling)
consistency_hash.array_sort: sort records ascending by sample_id then region_id
consistency_hash.json_encoding: compact separators comma and colon with no spaces utf-8 no trailing newline inside the hashed bytes
consistency_hash.digest: sha256 hex of those bytes; when no inference records exist hash the two byte compact json array []
consistency_hash.scenario_01_example: two regions eu-west and us-east each infer sample s1 class 1 so array is [{"predicted_class":1,"region_id":"eu-west","sample_id":"s1"},{"predicted_class":1,"region_id":"us-east","sample_id":"s1"}] then sha256 hex
consistency_hash.inference_without_lock: RUN_INFERENCE without LOCK_SAMPLE still contributes a hash record when probabilities are non-empty and must still emit a sample output row with empty normalized_features quantized and dequantized arrays
consistency_hash.scenario_41_example: inference on sample s9 without lock still sets consistency_hash from predicted_class 0 and emits sample row s9 with empty feature arrays
consistency_hash.scenario_64_example: eu-west and us-east both infer unlocked sample s9; hash array is [{"predicted_class":0,"region_id":"eu-west","sample_id":"s9"},{"predicted_class":1,"region_id":"us-east","sample_id":"s9"}] then sha256 hex
consistency_hash.scenario_49_example: lock only with no RUN_INFERENCE yields consistency_hash equal to sha256 of compact empty array []
consistency_hash.scenario_51_example: seq 3 REGISTER_REGION and LOCK_SAMPLE for us-east must process registration before lock so no UNKNOWN_REGION is emitted
